title: Exclusive | Databricks In Early Talks To Raise Funds At $225 Billion Valuation
html:
Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data-analytics software provider at about $225 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

The new financing would represent a nearly 20% increase from its valuation in August, when the company raised money at a $190 billion valuation. The raise, if successful, would show that investors still have an appetite to back AI startups at a time when some are increasingly voicing concerns about the speed and size of the AI boom and amid a broader selloff in AI stocks.
